m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Aren't they just the cutest--What!?! Someone poached one of our precious eggs?! This is terrible!
You think it was those rotting Thunder Horn Zombies? Calamity!
Those Hungry Dead came from the Cenote Mines. Please go into the depths and see if you can find our little egg!
Ah, thank you, Outsider. I'm glad that was over so easy!
Hello again, Outsider. I was curious if you might be able to assist me.
As you know, we are waiting to leave the village until our eggs have hatched.
Would you like to see them? They are very cute. They are in the Hatchery Nest near the Hall of Plumage. Tell me what you think!
Go and peek at our eggs in the Hatchery Nest near the Hall of Plumage. Tell me if they aren't the cutest things!
